description:
Tails and ships log files

Filebeat is an open source file harvester, mostly used to fetch logs files and feed them into logstash. Together with the libbeat lumberjack output is a replacement for logstash-forwarder.
Fixes
All
- Fix unknown type for map[string]string in otelmap. #52464
Filebeat
- Fix offset commits when using multiline in Journald and Kafka inputs. #52342 #51981
Heartbeat
- Bake Synthetics browser binaries into the Heartbeat Docker image. #52443 #52439
Libbeat
- Prevent stale autodiscover resources after Kubernetes leadership changes. #52425
Metricbeat
- Fix Azure module authentication on sovereign clouds (Government, China). #52432
